name: wordpress
title: WordPress
description: A fully installed WordPress: PHP 8.3 with the WordPress extension set, a local MariaDB, WP-CLI, Composer, and core installed into /workspace/public on port 8080. Arabic/RTL and WooCommerce are options, not follow-up work.

inputs.label: Site title
inputs.help: Shown in the browser tab and the admin bar. Change it later in Settings → General.

inputs.label: Admin email
inputs.help: The administrator account's address. No mail is sent during setup.

inputs.label: Admin password
inputs.help: Leave empty and a strong one is generated. Either way it is stored as the WP_ADMIN_PASSWORD project secret.

inputs.label: Site language
inputs.help: Arabic installs the translation and switches the admin to RTL; the timezone is set to Africa/Cairo.

inputs.label: Install WooCommerce
inputs.help: Installs and activates the plugin. Store currency, country and pages stay at WooCommerce's defaults.

inputs.label: Keep the sample posts
inputs.help: Off replaces Hello world! and the sample page with a single staging-notice page.
